samples: This module provides a generic immutable stack type with basic operations to create an empty stack, push an item, pop the top item, peek at the top item, and query size/emptiness. It also defines a bracket-balancing checker that scans text and returns true only when round and square brackets are properly nested and matched in order, ignoring all other characters. The included tests verify that popping an empty stack yields nothing and that push/peek/size behave as expected.

This module defines a generic immutable stack type with basic operations to create an empty stack, push an item, pop the top item, peek at the top item, and query its size or emptiness. It also includes a bracket-balance checker that scans text and returns true only when round and square brackets are properly nested and matched in order, ignoring all other characters. The included tests verify that popping an empty stack yields nothing and that the most recently pushed item is on top.

It also includes a bracket-balance checker that scans text and returns true only when round and square brackets are properly nested and matched in order, ignoring all other characters. The tests confirm that popping an empty stack yields nothing and that the most recently pushed item is on top.

This module provides an immutable generic stack type with basic operations to create an empty stack, push an item, pop the top item, and peek at the top item, plus a small `Sized` ability implementation so stacks can report their length and emptiness. It also includes a bracket-balancing checker that scans text and returns true only when round and square brackets are properly nested and matched in order.
